changelog:
Initial release of bold-highlights skill.

- Adds concise bold highlights to core concepts in each paragraph of an article.
- Ensures only 1–2 key words or short phrases per paragraph are bolded, following clear constraints.
- Avoids repeats in adjacent paragraphs and skips obvious context and proper nouns.
- Designed to make articles in ai-thoughts/docs/ more scannable while maintaining readability.
- Includes error handling for inappropriate contexts and user opt-outs.
summary: Add bold highlights to key concepts in each paragraph so readers can scan and capture the article's core points. Use when polishing an article in ai-thoughts/docs/ or when the user asks to make an article more scannable or add highlights.
